artifacts.preservation_scope: full-pytest.xml + environment-smoke.xml only; not full CI artifact copy

raw_capture: Canonical parsed JSON-RPC requests/results, not HTTP wire bytes. Borrower repair header result projects required fields and retains original parsed full-result SHA256. No provider authorization headers or secrets.
integer_domain: Arbitrary precision decimal strings or exact JSON integers, never IEEE754-only parsing
byte_domain_note: Binary gzip actual bytes and decoded canonical JSON have separate SHA256. LF artifact JSON bytes differ from CRLF checkouts; no equivalence claim.
